cues.text: 特斯拉这次新款跑车的发布演示

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 腾空翻了一圈，这两个动作
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 靠的其实是两套本事
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 轮胎朝着天，车却贴得牢牢的
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 等它飞起来，又没有翅膀
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 看不见的空气，一会儿负责压住
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 一会儿负责推开
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 家里的吸盘、吹鼓的气球
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 还有一扇门，都能帮我们想明白
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 先从贴住轨道的那一刻说起
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 吸盘按上瓷砖，里面一部分空气被挤出去
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 外面的空气压力更大
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 就把它压住了，边上漏了气
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 它很快就会掉
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 车底也围出了一片空间
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 四周的裙边挡住大部分漏气
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 风扇不停抽走里面的空气
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 压力一低，外面的空气就把车压向路面
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 这里没有抽成真空
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 边缘一直漏气，风扇就得一直抽
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 裙边贴得怎么样
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 风扇抽得多快，决定车被压得有多紧
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 尾翼通常要等车跑快了
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 气流足够强，才压得住
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 风扇可以自己搬运空气
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 车停着也能工作
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 这正是低速倒挂的关键
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 让轨道慢慢翻过去
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 始终朝向轨道，重力却不管车怎么摆
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 它的方向，一直朝下
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 到了平直的顶部
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 两股力才真正对着干
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 压差力大过车的重量
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 刚好一样大，还不够稳
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 拿一组假设数字算算
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 一千五百公斤的车
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 车底有效面积三平方米
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 大约五千帕的压差
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 就能接近托住整辆车的重量
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 五千帕，只是标准大气压的二十分之一
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 压力差乘上几平方米
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 力就很可观，实际还得留出余量
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 才能贴得稳
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 一旦车离开轨道
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 周围空气涌进来
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 低压空间维持不住
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 刚才那套办法就帮不上忙了
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 冲出坡道，靠惯性也能短暂腾空
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 但要继续向上加速
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 或者调整落地，就得额外出力
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 于是，另一套装置接手
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 气球一松手，气往后喷
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 打开阀门，让气体冲出喷嘴
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 也能得到反方向的推力
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 这就是冷气推进
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 冷，指这里没有靠燃烧产生喷气
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 推力大过重力，车就向上加速
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 要悬停，先让上升速度降到零
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 再让推力抵消重力
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 它还带着向上的速度
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 只是被重力越拉越慢
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 一侧喷得多，另一侧喷得少

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 车壳绕着它翻转
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 它自己仍然沿着一条路线移动
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 想让轮胎朝下落地

cues.text: 光关喷嘴可不行
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 还得从另一边，给它一个反方向的力矩
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 前面负责转起来
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 原来朝下的喷嘴
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 如果这时照样喷
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 反而把车推向地面
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 所以这类控制
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 要不断知道车朝哪儿、转得多快、离地多高
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 算好需要的力，再调整阀门
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 一个漂亮动作，靠的是连续修正
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 不过，储气罐里的气总有用完的时候
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 调压装置可以让供气稳定一段时间
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 省不了每次喷出去的气
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 推力、重量和储备
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 不等于每种路况都能重复
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained
